notes: Four-lane parallel sweep (ai / bigtech+hardware+mobile / devtools+cloud / security) covering 2026-10-13/14. Routine EGRESS_BLOCKED on almost every org-domain WebFetch; all lanes worked around it via WebSearch. Most of what the lanes surfaced (CES 2027, Google Cloud Next 2027, KubeCon EU 2027, RSAC 2027, ICLR 2027, Black Hat/DEF CON 2027, Amazon EKS 1.32, JDK 29, Geneva AI Summit, Claude Sonnet 5 support floor) turned out to already be on file, several of them already complete with better sourcing than the new findings, so this was a correction-light, addition-light run: a handful of genuinely new items (Anthropic's Claude 5.x family support-floor dates pulled straight from Anthropic's own model-deprecations page, Anthropic's Singapore office, Cloudflare Connect 2026, an Arm Holdings earnings date, a GitHub Enterprise Server EOL, a MongoDB Atlas EOL, a Mozilla/Sectigo legacy-root distrust date) plus two small corrections (ASML's Q3 earnings now carry actual reported results instead of just the date; NVIDIA GTC DC 2026 now has an end date).

data/events/2027-03.json also carries two near-duplicate JDK 28 GA entries ('...targeted-for-general-availabil...' and '...planned-general-availability...'), both dated 2027-03-23 — the devtools lane independently re-found this fact under a third phrasing; deliberately not filed to avoid compounding it. A maintainer should merge the existing pair.
data/events/2027-01.json still carries two near-duplicate Google Play Contacts/Location policy entries dated 2027-01-27 (standing issue from prior runs).

The bigtech lane found Google's own Play Console policy-deadlines table listing a related but distinct Contact Picker requirement at 2026-10-28, one day after the already-filed 'Google Play Console pre-review checks for Contacts/Location policy' (2026-10-27) — not filed, since it's unclear whether this is the same policy item under a new mechanism name or a genuinely separate deadline; a maintainer with reliable fetch access to support.google.com should reconcile before this is added, to avoid growing the existing Play-policy duplicate cluster.

Independent reporting (AppleInsider, 9to5Mac, citing Apple's own 8-K) suggests the Tim Cook -> John Ternus CEO transition took effect September 1, 2026, not October 1 as the existing 'Apple reportedly overhauls organization toward engineering-led structure under CEO Ternus' (2026-10-01) entry implies — not changed this run since the existing entry may be describing a distinct internal reorg rather than the CEO handover itself; worth reconciling against Apple's own filing.

The devtools/cloud lane found a reported AWS Lambda nodejs20.x runtime lockout schedule (function-creation blocked 2027-02-01, updates blocked 2027-03-03) only in third-party trackers, not confirmed on AWS's own Lambda runtimes page in this sweep's search results — not filed at 'rumored' confidence to avoid adding a weakly-sourced near-duplicate of the already-filed 'AWS delays Lambda deprecated-runtime lockout to March 2027' entry; a maintainer with working fetch access to the AWS Lambda runtime-support page should check whether nodejs20.x carries its own, earlier creation-block date.

The devtools/cloud lane's 'Google Cloud Next 2027' finding cited the same googlecloudevents.com FAQ URL already in the existing entry's source list, but called it 'confirmed' where the existing entry (filed after the same source was seen) deliberately kept it 'expected' since that domain isn't Google's own cloud.google.com — left at 'expected', not upgraded, since nothing new corroborates it.

The security lane could not find any breach, zero-day, or exploited-CVE news genuinely dated 2026-10-13/10-14 — the newest confirmed items (SonicWall SMA1000 CVE-2026-102255, Atlassian Data Center CVE-2026-21589, Rejetto HFS CVE-2026-61500) all predate the announcement window and were not yet in the CISA KEV catalog with a dated deadline as of this sweep, so none qualified for filing; worth re-checking once KEV status settles.

HHS's projected mid-2027 HIPAA Security Rule final-action date is an internal rulemaking-agenda target, not a binding deadline, and kept slipping even before this run (May 2026 -> July 2027) — not filed given how soft and non-actionable it is for an engineer's calendar.
